BASEPIDDIR.description: Directory where PID files for each interface are stored.

DODTIME.description: Time in seconds to wait between SIGTERM and SIGKILL in force_stop.

DAEMON.description: Full path to the dhcp_probe executable.

NAME.description: Service name used for PID file directory and init script naming.

ETC.description: Base configuration directory; config files are read from $ETC/$NAME/*.
